detail.longDescription: Hey everyone, I've always loved the simplicity of Go, but the only thing keeping me from switching all of my backends to Go is really one package, and one package only, which is Better-Auth. It's just so easy to use: simple plugin, and start working. It's got everything I need: organizations, teams, billing, social auth, everything. I tried to scour GitHub and the open source community for anything remotely close to it in Go, and I honestly couldn't find anything that was worth it, so I just decided to make it myself. It's an open-source Go package. It is not 100% feature parity with Better-Auth yet, but it's getting there. Would love some feedback. For anyone to try it out, it works with pretty much all of those routers: Chi, Echo, Fiber, Mux and more. Any feedback is greatly appreciated. Oh, and it's also my very first open source repo, so I'm learning as I go.
